sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: Cinematic photograph of a dark wooden creator desk almost buried in long winding strips of ivory paper and scattered small blank square frames. A tiny clean paper boat is trapped among those strips. A single strong amber light isolates the boat; deep petrol blue shadows. The visual story is a small idea buried under work before it can be seen, readable physical objects and quiet human absence, photoreal paper grain, 35mm commercial photograph, no printed words or logos.
